_comment: Activates brand-lint from the miragon-brand plugin: the Claude Code hook while editing, and the brand job in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs the copy vendored in .miragon/brand-lint/. The repo is English, so the German-only copy rules are off: du (A1), umlauts (A3), German passive (A4), German claim (A7), gender forms (A11) and C5 (one language per surface, German by default). Em dashes as connectors (A2), spellings (A10), the anti-slop patterns (S*), palette, token and dark-mode rules stay on. Files vendored from Miragon/corporate-identity (the docs kit, brand-lint itself, the design tokens) are checked at their source. Pictures and diagrams a tool renders (docs/public/shots/, test and e2e fixtures) keep the tool's colours, and test data may carry raw colours on purpose.
